title: @intentsolutions/core authoring schema index v1
description: Catalog of authoring-contract schemas for the Spec Authority Kernel (SAK). Source of truth: plan 033 § 14.10 / § 14.A (intent-eval-lab/000-docs/033-PP-PLAN-skill-refiner-sak-amendment-v7-2026-05-28.md). The marketplace-tier foundation is the 4-fold composable $defs that all six authoring contracts inherit. Per-contract schemas (skill-frontmatter, plugin-manifest, agent-definition, mcp-config, hook-config, marketplace-catalog) land in subsequent SAK phases.
